title: Affine algebra-module presentation from underlying quasi-coherence
statement: Let S be a scheme, A a quasi-coherent commutative O_S-algebra, and G an A-module. For every affine open U of S, if the underlying O_S-module of G restricted to U is quasi-coherent, then G restricted to the slice over U admits a presentation by coproducts of copies of A restricted to U.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 0H88, proof, second paragraph; EGA I, Proposition 9.6.1

proof.text: Obtain global generators using nonempty_affine_algebraModule_generatingSections on G.over U. Prove that the underlying kernel of their evaluation map is quasi-coherent using affine_algebraModule_kernel_isQuasicoherent. Apply the same generating-sections lemma to that kernel. Assemble the two families directly with the Mathlib Presentation constructor.
